parameters.query:
WITH 
emp AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    phone,
    avatar_url,
    designation,
    joining_date,
    employment_type,
    work_location,
    role,
    is_active
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
     OR LOWER(email) = LOWER('{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}')
  LIMIT 1
),
today_att AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    date::TEXT,
    check_in,
    check_out,
    status,
    status_label,
    expected_checkout_time AS expected_check_out_time,
    work_duration_minutes,
    total_duration_minutes,
    lunch_duration_minutes,
    late_allowance_used,
    is_half_day_case,
    notes
  FROM attendances
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
    AND date = CURRENT_DATE
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly_att AS (
  SELECT 
    month_key,
    total_recorded_days,
    present_days,
    on_time_days,
    within_buffer_days,
    late_days,
    late_allowances_used,
    late_allowances_remaining,
    half_days,
    absent_days,
    leave_days,
    holidays,
    total_work_hours,
    average_hours_per_day
  FROM v_monthly_attendance_summary
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
    AND month_key = TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
  LIMIT 1
),
leave_data AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(SUM(available), 0) AS total_leave_available,
    COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
      'type', leave_type,
      'label', label,
      'total', total,
      'used', used,
      'available', available
    )), '[]'::json) AS balances
  FROM leave_balances
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
    AND year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT
),
ot_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE status = 'APPROVED') / 60.0, 0), 1) AS total_approved_hours,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') / 60.0, 0), 1) AS total_pending_hours,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reimbursement_status = 'PENDING') AS reimbursement_pending_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(duration_minutes) FILTER (WHERE early_leave_status = 'AVAILABLE') / 60.0, 0), 1) AS early_leave_hours_available
  FROM overtime_records
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
),
next_holiday AS (
  SELECT json_build_object(
    'name', name,
    'date', date::TEXT,
    'day', day,
    'type', type,
    'description', description,
    'isOfficeClosed', is_office_closed
  ) AS holiday
  FROM holidays
  WHERE date >= CURRENT_DATE
  ORDER BY date ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
notifs AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_read = FALSE) AS unread_count
  FROM notifications
  WHERE employee_id = (SELECT id FROM emp)
)
SELECT 
  (CASE WHEN emp.id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS employee_found,
  row_to_json(emp.*) AS employee,
  row_to_json(today_att.*) AS today_attendance,
  row_to_json(monthly_att.*) AS monthly_summary,
  (SELECT total_leave_available FROM leave_data) AS total_leave_available,
  (SELECT balances FROM leave_data) AS leave_balances,
  row_to_json(ot_data.*) AS overtime_summary,
  (SELECT holiday FROM next_holiday) AS upcoming_holiday,
  (SELECT unread_count FROM notifs) AS unread_notifications_count
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN emp ON true
LEFT JOIN today_att ON true
LEFT JOIN monthly_att ON true
LEFT JOIN ot_data ON true
LIMIT 1;
